# Core Rule 6 - Area Rulings
The Zone is divided into areas with different PvP and engagement rules. Make sure you know what zone you're in before starting any confrontation. For detailed PvP engagement and death rules, see [textlink="Rule 7 - PvP & Combat" link="RuleC7Stalker"].
A zone ruling indicator is located in the UI near health and stamina, and can be hovered over for clarification.
## Transition Rules
PvP should not be done near transitions (portals) to other regions. You should remain at least 0.5 to 1 screen away from transitions to maintain fair play. It can be hard to judge as some transitions are in tighter areas, so it's better to err on the side of caution. You may only PvP near a transition if someone has fled to the transition or has been sitting there for over 30 seconds.
You should be at least three screens away from Rookie Village to initiate PvP or robbing, or one screen away from a Green Zone or faction base. *Camping a transition or Green Zone will be punished severely.*
[color=#008000]Green Zones[/color]
PvP is strictly prohibited in these areas. These areas serve as safe hubs for trading and are often visited by new or inexperienced players. No form of player combat is allowed within these zones. No robbing or looting should take place in a Green Zone, including against SSD players.
Green zones cannot be entered within 5 minutes of exiting PvP.
Locations: - [color=#008000]Rookie Village[/color] in Cordon, including Sidorovich's bunker. *[textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"], [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"], [textlink="Military" link="RuleF3"], and [textlink="Monolith" link="RuleF4"] are NOT allowed in or around Rookie Village at any time.* - [color=#008000]The 100 Rads Bar[/color] in Rostok. [textlink="Duty" link="RuleF8"] controls Rostok. Any hostile or associated factions may be denied entry or engaged on sight within Rostok, and may be engaged by Duty inside the 100 Rads Bar following Gray Zone rules. Enter at your own risk. [textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"] and [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"] are explicitly disallowed access. - [color=#008000]The Fleamarket and Bar[/color] in Garbage, excluding the russian roulette den.
[color=#808080]Gray Zone[/color]
PvP and robbing are allowed only after there is an RP exchange of at least two sentences from both parties in the encounter, if allowed depending on faction rules and faction relations.
[textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"] and [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"] are not allowed to use equipment above T2 within gray zones.
Locations: - Cordon (except the Southern Border — [textlink="Military" link="RuleF3"] can open fire on stalkers approaching the Southern Checkpoint).
[color=#4169E1]Faction Bases[/color]
Faction base owners have the final say. They may use lethal force if the offender is violating their rules when appropriate or after escalation.
- Camping a faction base or its only access points is prohibited. Any faction that is hostile to the base-owning faction must remain at least 0.5 screens away. Faction bases shouldn't be fired directly into or out of. - Faction bases can't be returned to within 5 minutes of leaving PvP. - Anyone Allied with or Neutral to the base owning faction is prohibited from engaging in PvP within the base unless given permission by the base owner and may be asked to follow rules set by the owning faction. - Anyone Hostile to or at War with the base owning faction may treat the base as a Yellow Zone when inside of it. Bring enemies into your base at your own risk.
[color=#FFFF00]Yellow Zones[/color]
PvP and robbing are allowed depending on faction rules and faction relations. Factions at war are allowed to PvP on sight in a Yellow Zone.
Locations: - Anything not specified in the other zones.
[color=#FF0000]Red Zones[/color]
On-sight PvP is allowed with neutral or hostile factions. Same faction members and allies of your faction should not be shot at.
Locations: - Red Forest - Yantar Underground Lab - Jupiter Plant - Capture Points
[color=#000000]Black Zones[/color]
On-sight PvP is allowed regardless of faction alignment. Same faction members should not be shot at.
Locations: - Limansk
